verification.dataset2_annotation_type: 2D Bounding Boxes (class_id, x, y, w, h)
blockers: BLOCKER-01: Dataset 2 does not contain facial landmark annotations (only 2D bounding boxes for awake/drowsy).
BLOCKER-02: Ultralytics YOLOv12 release only supports object detection ('detect') and lacks facial landmark/pose heads ('yolo12n-pose' does not exist).
verification.recommendation: Use YOLO for bounding-box driver face/drowsiness detection; use dedicated facial landmark solution (e.g. MediaPipe / OpenCV DLib) or CNN eye-state classifiers for pupil/eyelid state.
